entities.name: Henri de Massue, Earl of Galway
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henri de Massue, 2nd Marquis de Ruvigny, Earl of Galway, was a French Huguenot soldier and diplomat who was influential in the English service in the Nine Years' War and the War of the Spanish Succession.
